# arianet_ssh_key (Data Source)

One of the account's SSH keys (`/api/v1/ssh-keys`), by `id`, `name` or `fingerprint`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "arianet_ssh_key" "me" {
  name = "laptop"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `fingerprint` (String) SHA256 fingerprint.
- `id` (String) Key ID.
- `name` (String) Key name.

### Read-Only

- `is_default` (Boolean) Whether it is the default key.
- `public_key` (String) Public key.
